title: Small $q$-kernels in digraphs
summary: We address three questions of Spiro [Europ. J. Combin., 133:Paper No. 104307, 2026] on smallest $q$-kernels in digraphs. All three questions are on the existence of small $q$-kernels in digraphs, where 'smallness' is measured in different ways. We answer one of these questions in the affirmative, and the other two in the negative. We further study the latter two questions in the context of bipartite digraphs.
